page.layout: One printed page. Running head with page number at top. One column of running text, with one marginal note in the right margin beside the line "Dallæani". Gathering signature below the last line.

main_text.p: byterij mentio fiat ; sed ita ut id nomen ministrorum primi gradus Collegium necessario significet, non autem secundi, quibus scilicet ordinandi & imponendi manus facultas, huic Collegio à Paulo attributa, nulla, inquit, ex eorum dogmate est, qui hunc secundum gradum à primo diversum statuunt. Palmarium sanè argumentum & aliquâ Vindiciarum Auctoris responsione dignissimum.

Excussis rationibus quibus Dallæani XXXIV. argumenti ex nominum confusione dedu-cti, vim atque pondus elevare nisus est doctissimus Ignatianorum patronus ; ad ea refellenda quæ pro tribus sacris ordinibus scripsit, libenter nos accingeremus, ni vetaret ut diximus instituti ratio : Tamen quamvis quæstionem illam indiscuf-sam relinquere decreverim, duo aut tria testimonia contra trium sacrorum ordinum numerum, à nemine quod sciam ad-huc adducta, describere non pigebit, ut appareat quæ fuerit Veterum de Ordinum sacrorum institutione sententia ; Primum desumptum est ex Libello de pressu-ris Ecclesiasticis Attonis Episcopi Vercellensis & decimi sæculi Scriptoris ; Is enim tom. 8. page.notes: Long s read as plain s throughout. The first word "byterij" is a line fragment at the top of the page and is left as printed. "pressu-ris" is read as "pressuris" from the Latin sense; the scan is clear. The printed "6 3." keeps its space. The signature "S s" is written as "S s". Show-through from the reverse side is faint in the middle of the page and was ignored. The Google watermark at the bottom right was left out.
